t: These Keep Safe latex grip gloves are essential hand protection for various manual work applications. Featuring a durable latex coated palm, these builder's construction gloves provide a firm grip and excellent abrasion resistance in both dry and wet conditions, making them ideal for general maintenance and demanding site tasks. The wing thumb design enhances comfort and flexibility during extended use, while high dexterity allows for precise handling. These work gloves are designed for trade professionals requiring reliable hand protection and a secure hold on tools and materials.
